subqueries.label: primary
subqueries.search_query: business coach worth it small business owner
subqueries.ranking_query: Firsthand posts from small business owners (especially women, creatives, product or service businesses doing roughly 100k+ in sales) deciding whether hiring a business coach, mastermind or consultant was worth it, or why they did not. Exclude coaches promoting their own services.

subqueries.label: no-time
subqueries.search_query: no time for business coach overwhelmed owner
subqueries.ranking_query: Small business owners saying they are too busy, maxed out, or cannot add one more thing, especially about coaching, programs or masterminds feeling like more work. Exclude vendor marketing.

subqueries.label: agency-vs-coach
subqueries.search_query: hired marketing agency waste of money small business
subqueries.ranking_query: Owners who hired a marketing agency or PR firm hoping for more sales and describe what happened. Exclude agencies advertising.
